meta.scope: Nationwide directory of U.S. MD and DO programs, institution/location level.
methodology: Directory completeness and school-specific admissions-profile completeness are tracked separately.
The AAMC OCD scope includes U.S. MD programs with preliminary, provisional, or full LCME accreditation as of June 1, 2026.
AACOM reported 48 accredited colleges of osteopathic medicine at 75 teaching locations as of June 23, 2026.
No acceptance rate was inferred from applicants divided by matriculants.
Median GPA, median MCAT, prerequisites, deadlines, AP policies, and situational-judgment-test requirements are null unless verified from an official source.
Some multi-campus institutions appear as separate entries where applicants may select or matriculate to distinct locations.
This expanded file is appropriate as a nationwide browsing/filtering directory. It is not yet complete enough for admissions-chance modeling.

freshness.reason: Per-school GPA/MCAT/acceptance stats change every application cycle; 203/206 stat profiles are currently unfilled
freshness.sourceToMonitor: AAMC MSAR + individual school admissions pages
freshness.note: First customer of the refresh pipeline: fill priority-school stats (NC + user target list) first, then expand.
